**Maple Street Repaving: Oct 30 & 31**

Good news, neighbors: Maple Street is getting a fresh coat of pavement! Here's what you need to know.

**📅 When**
Thursday, Oct 30 and Friday, Oct 31

**🚗 Move your car**
All vehicles must be off Maple Street from **7am to 5pm** on both days. Please park on a nearby street the night before so you're not caught off guard.

**🗑️ Trash pickup**
Trash trucks won't be able to get through, so pickup will move to the **main road** on both days. Please bring your bins out there instead of the curb in front of your house.

**💡 Quick tips**
- Plan for limited access to your driveway during work hours.
- Let any guests, delivery drivers, and caregivers know ahead of time.
- Check in on neighbors who may need a hand moving their car or bins.

Thank you for your patience. Smooth new pavement will be worth it!

---

Two quick notes: I wrote Oct 30 as Thursday and Oct 31 as Friday, but please double-check that against your calendar, since I didn't verify the weekdays. Also, you may want to add a contact name or phone number for questions, and a line about when bins should be at the main road.

# Maple Street Repaving: Oct 30 & 31

**Heads up, neighbors! Maple Street is getting a fresh new surface.** 🛣️

## 📅 When
**Friday, Oct 30 and Saturday, Oct 31**
**7:00 am to 5:00 pm** both days

## 🚗 What you need to do
- **Move your car off Maple Street before 7:00 am** on Oct 30. Please don't park on the street at all until 5:00 pm on Oct 31.
- Park on a side street or in your driveway, or ask a friend if you need a spot.
- Cars left on the street may be towed, and the crew can't pave around them.

## 🗑️ Trash & recycling
Pickup will **move to the main road** on these days. Please bring your bins out to the main road instead of the curb in front of your house. Bins on Maple Street could get in the crew's way.

## 💡 Good to know
- Expect noise, and a bit of a smell from the fresh asphalt.
- Plan for limited driveway access during work hours. If you need to leave by car, do it before 7:00 am or after 5:00 pm.
- Stay off freshly paved sections. Wet asphalt is sticky and can ruin shoes and tires.
- Please keep pets and kids away from the work zone.

## 🎃 Halloween note
Oct 31 is Halloween. Work should wrap up by 5:00 pm, but keep an eye on any cones or barriers left for evening trick-or-treaters.

## ❓ Questions?
Contact **[name / phone / email]**.

Thank you for your patience. We'll have a smoother ride soon! 🙌

---

**Before you publish:**
- **Confirm the details.** I wrote "main road" as you gave it. Naming the exact street and a pickup time (for example, "bins out by 7 am") would help. If pickup is at a different time than usual, say so.
- **Check the claims in the "Good to know" section.** I added the towing warning, the driveway-access note and the pavement tips as typical for paving jobs. Delete any that don't apply, especially towing, unless the city has confirmed it.
- **Add a rain date if there is one.** Paving often slips with bad weather, so a line like "If it rains, work moves to [date]" prevents confusion.
- **Time-sensitive.** Oct 30 is only four days away, so you may want to send this out by email or post it to a neighborhood group now, not just wait for the newsletter.
